attchmntText: Carraro India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Carraro India Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 06th November 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR6,965 million, a 19% year-on-year increase. EBITDA for the quarter was INR652 million, with margins at 9.2%. For the first half of FY27, revenue grew 15% to INR12,411 million. Domestic revenue accounted for approximately 70% of total sales. The company cited rising input costs for steel and castings as the primary driver for margin compression. Management expects full-year revenue growth to remain within the 10% to 15% range. Absolute EBITDA growth is targeted for FY27, with progressive margin improvement anticipated as cost recoveries catch up. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Carraro India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Carraro India Limited has intimated the schedule of a meeting with investors and analysts. The group meeting will take place on 17th November, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. IST onwards. The venue is the company’s facilities in Ranjangaon, Pune, Maharashtra. The company notes that the meeting schedule may change due to exigencies. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed during the interactions. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
